title:
Freshly foraged cleavers 🍃🍋

BENEFITS✨

 💧 Supports hydration – A refreshing way to increase your daily water intake.
* 🌿 Traditionally used to support the lymphatic system – Cleavers have long been used in herbal medicine to support normal lymphatic function, although strong clinical evidence is limited.
* 🚽 May have a mild diuretic effect – Cleavers are traditionally used to encourage normal urine production, which may help with mild fluid retention.
* 🍋 Source of vitamin C – Lemon provides vitamin C, which supports the immune system and contributes to normal collagen formation for healthy skin.
* 🛡️ Contains antioxidants – Lemon and cleavers both contain plant compounds with antioxidant properties.
* 🌱 Low in calories – Adds flavour to water without added sugar.
* 🍃 Refreshing and seasonal – A simple way to enjoy fresh, foraged ingredients.
